entities.summary: Niconico, Inc. , known before 2012 as Nico Nico Douga , is a Japanese video sharing service based in Tokyo, Japan. "Niconico" or "nikoniko" is the Japanese ideophone for smiling. As of 2021, Niconico is the 34th most-visited website in Japan, according to Alexa Internet. Niconico is a software, arising around 2006-12-12.
